action.rationale: Fresh problem (dim=10) with full budget available (100 evals) and deterministic, cheap evaluations. Probing first (~12% ≈ 12 evals) will reveal landscape features to choose an effective optimizer before spending the 50-eval rounds.

Probes indicate a likely single smooth basin (fdc_spearman=0.7343, frac_extreme=0.0) in 10D with deterministic, cheap evaluations, so a local method should win but we’ll hedge with CMA-ES. A small race (36 evals) will quickly identify the best optimizer while preserving 52 evals for focused improvement.

Bobyqa has stalled (stall_evals=26) with no improvement during its 15-eval rung in the race, suggesting local convergence near 1196.24. Probes indicate a single-funnel landscape (fdc_spearman=0.7343), and CMA-ES was already close (1197.76 in 5 evals), so switching should escape the stall and explore the basin more effectively. With 58 evals left, this keeps room for a final polish afterward.

Only 8 evaluations remain and CMA-ES has stalled for 9 evals with popsize 10, making further CMA-ES progress unlikely; we should spend the end of the budget refining the incumbent 1104.44 with a local solver. BOBYQA is derivative-free and suitable for small final budgets in 10D.
